name: d8-whole-shot-thomson-diagnostic
purpose: Rule out or retain D8/S6 without a new competition score or model fit

selection.source: The artifact's val_files in stored order

target.definition: Per-shot mean true-minus-ensemble error over PCA coefficients, transformed with the old artifact's fitted TargetScaler

inner_cv.selection_metric: sklearn explained_variance_score with multioutput=variance_weighted; maximum mean fold score, smallest alpha on ties

supplemental_reporting.outer_frame_weighted: Report explained_variance_score and r2_score on the same 338 diagnostic shots with sample_weight equal to each shot's EFIT frame count and multioutput=variance_weighted; this does not select alpha or change the primary gate
supplemental_reporting.promotion_rule: A primary gate pass with less than 0.05 frame-weighted explained variance is not promoted to a native-score test; the original D8 arithmetic prices 0.05 at only about 0.0001 of S

control: DummyRegressor(strategy=mean) fitted on the same 1000 calibration shots
pre_fit_amendments: The first extraction failed fast on d3d_shot_d4fc5902f4.parquet, which has one EFIT frame. Before any Ridge fit or diagnostic target inspection, the declared last-minus-first duration was made explicit as 0 ms for a one-frame shot. The shot and all 1338 stored validation filenames remain in the split.

At 453/1338 summaries, before any Ridge fit or diagnostic target inspection, the second extraction was interrupted to add frame-count-weighted outer reporting. The unweighted primary gate and alpha search stay unchanged. The weighted result limits promotion because native geometry/R2 pool frames.
limitation: All 1338 shots were already used to early-stop the historical ensemble; this is a diagnostic screen, not independent confirmation or competition S
